items.title: Illinois Tool Works (ITW) Stock Trades Up, Here Is Why

The industrial products maker posted revenue of $4.3 billion, a 6.1% increase year on year, surpassing consensus estimates. Earnings came in at $2.84 per share, which was also ahead of expectations.
